messages:
leah.partnerships: Kicking off a short thread to align on marketplace readiness for the joint GTM with CloudCorp and AccelerateX. Launch target: 2025-11-20 16:00 PT (embargoed). Need final press one-pager, hero art with two hardware badges, SI onboarding checklist, and tenant provisioning SLA by EOD Mon. @mike_gTM @owen_engineering @tess_prod

mike_gTM: Will draft headline + short blog (300-450 words) by tomorrow AM. I'll ask partner comms for a quote and logo SVGs. Suggest CTA: "Try Redwood Inference on the CloudCorp Marketplace" to surface partner context.

tess_prod: SI checklist items I'm tracking:
- KMS/HSM mapping and example playbook
- Network egress & proxy config (sample ipranges)
- SAML/OIDC tenant mapping notes
- On-prem install quickstart + rollback steps
I'll upload template to the shared drive and set partner perms.

owen_engineering: Minimal manifest and auth snippet for listing (paste below). Staging preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace/mx-preview-2025

```
integration: redwood-marketplace
manifest_version: "1.0"
auth: oauth2
endpoints:
  - /v1/generate
  - /v1/embeddings
fallback_policy: rwd-large -> rwd-medium
```

owen_engineering: Note: we'll include a short sentence in metadata about automatic fallback between verified variants. This affects routing for Dedicated customers.

rachel_ops: Ops notes: hardware-backed tenant provisioning requires 72h lead time; cloud-only tenants 48h. Need legal to confirm marketplace SLA wording. Created ticket #MP-542 to track provisioning templates.

samir_prod: For SI scoping, I'll assemble an integration acceptance checklist (integration tests, perf baselines, and validation harness). Will add a section for hardware validation with AccelerateX.

mike_gTM: On press: short headline, TL;DR, one partner quote, and a 1-paragraph technical blurb. I'll coordinate with PR to prepare embargo PDF.

leah.partnerships: Timeline proposal:
- Mon AM: blog first draft + hero PNG + partner logos (SVG)
- Mon PM: SI checklist + manifest into repo + Ops SLA draft
- Tue AM: embargo PDF + distribution list to PR/legal
- Tue PM: staging integration + dry run
- Launch week: publish post-embargo and flip listing live

launch-bot: DRY RUN SCHEDULED  dr-1777777  2025-11-18T09:00:00-08:00  Participants: leah.partnerships, mike_gTM, tess_prod, owen_engineering, rachel_ops, samir_prod

leah.partnerships: Please flag any blockers now. If none, I'll collect assets and submit the embargo request to legal tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:"
